Results.ReviewText: The kettle is an excellent cooker and with a few added accessories it is possible to do a fine job of cooking most anything. I would highly recommend the charcoal baskets which can be used in many different configurations to achive separate cooking zones and effectively manage charcoal burn. The vents and ash catcher work very well, but removing the ash dump pan is a bit finicky. The only real ding I would mention is the wheels and legs are pretty cheesy for a premium cooker.  I replaced mine with a nice aftermarket cart with a table top and shelf plus a lid holder. I really appreciate Weber quality. I'be got a Weber Spirit gas grill that I've been cooking on for 10 years. With a once a year pressure washing it is still working  fine. I expect the same performance from the Kettle.
Results.Title: Great kettle!

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, easy to control temperature, very pleased with operation of grill and easy to dispose of used charcoal
Results.Title: Best grill i have used

Results.ReviewText: As with my former kettle grill, this is a great product and performs just as I wanted it. My only regret is that Weber no longer offers the 18 inch version of this grill… With the Ash catcher. I feel the Ash catcher is critical and I did not need a grill quite this large because I am only one person but I did get the, larger one because I had no other choice. I did find day brand online that was smaller with an ash catcher… But I felt more comfortable staying with the Weber name.
Results.Title: Ash catcher is key!

Results.ReviewText: My biggest issue is the top vent not having a heat resistant handle. I burned my thumb and index finger before realizing this. The grill I had prior had a heat resistant handle on it so I touched it unconsciously. lol instead of grilled ribs I grilled my hand. I also dislike the position of the thermometer. All and all it’s a great grill and I enjoy cooking on it every weekend. It gets the job done. The grill rack also opens on both sides and that’s a plus. I would recommend. Great buy for the price 100%.
Results.Title: It was great….untill it wasn’t 🥸🥸

Results.ReviewText: This Grill was easy to assemble, with clear instructions.  Once assembled, I found the heat management intuitive, with cooking results superior to my previous grill.  I really like the ability to open the grate to add coal as needed throughout the cook.  The lid being able to hang directly on the drum is another nice feature.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this to replace our very well used Weber charcoal grill we've had since 2005 (19 years!). Love the updated features such as the ash bucket instead of the tray, tool hooks on the handle and they included the upgraded hinged grill rack. They also improved how the legs attach to the kettle, no more losing legs as you're moving the grill. And for the extra few dollars- the copper color is a show stopper!
Results.Title: Great improvements

Results.ReviewText:
Warranty replacement of my 22" kettle lid.
Great customer service.
Results.Title: Warranty Replacement

Results.ReviewText: I've cooked on Weber Kettles at home for almost 50 years. I bought this one for a vacation  home I share with my family, where the grills have always been subpar. I inaugurated it by smoking a  rack of pork and then grilling shrimp straight from the ocean. I look forward to many years of seaside barbequing.
Results.Title: Decades of great food

Results.ReviewText: My father had a bronze colored Weber Grill. My father passed away in 1990. The Grill passed away April 2024.  The grill came to me after he passed. Years later I gave it to a friend for his cabin in the north. He gave it back 10 years later and I had it for a couple years at my cabin in the North. Then I bought an Weber Gas grill and asked my nephew Bill ( named after mt father ) if he would want it. He was overwhelmed with happiness. He s  said yes it has  Grampas DNA anll over it. You see,  Every Sunday in summer the had his family over and he cooked on the grill. Fish fry using a cast iron pan on his Weber, hamburgers and Brats..Well as I said the grill crumbled early this spring after 40 plus years. My nephew sent me a text telling how sad he was That Grampas grill with his DNA all over it was done. The memories of Grampa and his grill will live on. My nephew now has a new Bronze colored Weber Grill and is carrying the tradition on! We hope his grandchildren (none yet) will be able to remember their Grampas Bronze colored Grill! It’s more than just a grill!
Results.Title: Grampa had a Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Kettle grill, the previous one only lasted 20 years.  The grill doesn't need any spit system as indirect cooking does a perfect job on roasts, chicken and even turkey.  The new ash catcher is great, making it easier to keep the grill clean..\
Results.Title: Greatness Continued

Results.ReviewText: I really have enjoyed my Weber 22 inch grill. It grills and smokes great! I am very impressed with its ability to hold heat. I’ve smoked two pork butts on it and ribs, they turned out perfect!
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve always cooked on a gas grill and recentl purchased a Weber charcoal grill. These are the best burgers I’ve ever cooked!
Results.Title: Charcoal is the way to go!

Results.ReviewText: I love the Weber 22" Premium charcoal grill. It's just the right size for my family. The ash bin and grill grate are worth the extra money from the standard. I'm really happy with the ability to smoke with different accessories.
Results.Title: I love my Weber premium charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Classic! Love cooking on my kettle! Ah, nostalgia...
Results.Title: It's called "the original" for a reason

Results.ReviewText: Great charcoal grill.   Switched back from gas and not looked back.
Results.Title: Best simple charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced a Weber grill that died after 25 years of heavy use. It is better made than the one I had and I’m very satisfied.
Results.Title: Happy

Results.ReviewText: Great size for grilling! Many accessories help get daily use and cooking is evenly shared over the entire surface.
Results.Title: Great for grilling

Results.ReviewText: Exactly what I expect, and demand, of a grill. Glad I decided to go for the extra features on the Premium.
Results.Title: Weber 22" Premium Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I have returned to charcoal grilling after many years of gas grilling.  I like the improvements of the ash dump, temperature, and folding grill access.  Quality is still evident.  Good product.
Results.Title: Weber Quality

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.. lave the warrantee.. I like the hinged grate for access to coals while grilling. Easy clean and vent adjustments. Only wish is that a shelf in included for this price..
Results.Title: Great grill..

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill!  Best charcoal grill around!!  Easy to maintain
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill .I also purchased the side charcoal baskets! I can put my food in the middle of my grill with a foil pan under everything.My food comes out fantastic! I use some wood chips also . The flavor is fantastic! The grill is easy to maintain . I don’t have to stand guard or fight grease flames.It’s a pleasure to bar- b -que using this method!
Results.Title: Easy breezey

Results.ReviewText: We have been Weber charcoal grill fans for over 40 years. They are the best. Easy to cook on and consistent. Great food from steaks, vegetables and fish to smoking ribs and brisket.
Results.Title: The Onky Grill You Need

Results.ReviewText: Beautiful grill. Easy to use   Easy to clean perfect size for the family
Results.Title: The finest

Results.ReviewText: Very user friendly online instructions, 30 minutes by myself with kids stopping me with questions
Results.Title: Grilling made easy Every day!

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear the enamal is chipping on your lid. We are here to help and will be sure to look into this for you. Please check your email for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Paint is already coming off the edge of this grill....I'd say it's junk if it starts falling off after 2 uses.
Results.Title: paint coming off after 2 uses.

Results.ReviewText:
It is wonderful, legs were a pain to install, but this things cooks great. 
Especially when using the snake method.
Results.Title: WONDERFUL COOKER

Results.ReviewText:
Disappointed. Have had Weber charcoal grills for years and feel that the "premium" charcoal grill is not made as well as previous purchases of the "original". I purchased the premium because I'm now in a townhouse development and had concerns about blowing ash. 
The ash catcher takes too much attention to remove and attach. Should be more simple to manage. Some of the parts are flimsy and can be noticed when assembling. Save $70 and get the original
Results.Title: Disappointed

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and will be sure to share this with our team for consideration. If there is anything we can do to help please reach out direct. Thank you for being a long time Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber over 44 years. I do like this latest iteration except they omitted the second handle and the handle on the lid has been shifted 90 degrees. The ash trap is better but the lid doesn’t fit as well. All said, I will still buy another Weber.
Results.Title: 3rd Weber

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear about the missing parts upon arrival. Our Care team will reach out to follow up with you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grill arrived in a promptly time. However, it was missing parts. The leg kit and wheel caps were missing. This created a problem because I had planned on taking the grill on an out of state camping trip. I contacted customer service, they were very professional, and shipped the missing parts out. Overall, the grill works great. I would recommend buying in a store instead of online.
Results.Title: Missing Parts

Results.ReviewText: Great product. It’s the only grill I will ever use.  I used one for 20 years, and finally bought a new one.
Results.Title: Weber for life

Results.ReviewText: We’re very happy we got this more simple version. The green color looks great and the hood thermometer is very helpful!
Results.Title: A good color choice

Results.ReviewText: My Dad had a Webber Kettle grill when I was a kid, and I have had three in my adult life.  I love them.  A Webber is the perfect grill for everyday grilling.  If you take care of it, it will last for years!
Results.Title: Webber Fan

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill I've been wanting one for a long time. We had one when I was a kid in the 80s. I finally got my self one and I will be using it more then my propane weber.
Results.Title: Great!

Results.ReviewText: Great Charcoal Grill.  Could be cheaper.  But overall great
Results.Title: A Great Charcoal Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for you feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. We are so sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with the design of the ash catcher and the one touch cleaning system. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. If you need further assistance please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this product in July 2023. it is my 4th Weber since 1976 (48 years) I didn't even hesitate to look at another vendor. I am so disappointed. The kettle is no longer sturdy as it is now a much thinner material. And the single most disappointing aspect is the ash catcher single stroke or whatever cleaning system. It is the cheapest design you could possibly deploy. Not only is it difficult to attach and stay on, but the air adjustments are challenging to understand - pathetic. What is wrong with simple percentage of airflow? . (see photo) The cost reducing of this product has cheapened it to being disappointing. I suggest restoring it to it previous level of quality and raise the price to do so. Again, you only get what you pay for and I did not pay for what used to be a quality product.
Results.Title: Disappointed After All These years

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill.  Wouldn't own anything else.  Top notch quality
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent charcoal grill. Good sturdy grates and heavy gsuge steal body. I'm not crazy about the flip up sides on the top grate, however. Doesn't really serve me a purpose. If I need to add more charcoal I will remove the cooking grate regardless.  I do not grill with indirect heat though, so the flip up sides will be beneficial for those that do.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill for the price.

Results.ReviewText: I have had weber grills before, and switched to another grill to save money. Decided to go back to the best grill for my needs, weber grill. I love it.
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: The Gold Standard for generations of grillers. It works perfectly, every single time. No gadgets, no technology, no plugs, just simple bowls of perfection.
Results.Title: The Perfect Grilling Machine

Results.ReviewText: I really like my new kettle grill. It was time to get a new one.
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: The kettle on the bottom makes for very easy disposal of the ashes. Much better than the original plate catch and much less messy
Results.Title: Excellent product

Results.UserLocation: Hide-A-Way Hills Ohio, Walton WV, Naples FL
Results.ReviewText: I love the Weber Kettle Grill. If you’re going to cook on charcoal, I believe it is the best choice. It is quick to assemble and easy to use. I have one at each of my 3 properties. I have an offset “stick burner”, a vertical charcoal smoker, a pellet grill, and a trailer mounted reverse flow smoker. I use the Webers the most. Great for smoking, grilling or searing.
Results.Title: Great for smoking, grilling, or searing.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill.  Quality that can not be matched.
Results.Title: Best of the best

Results.ReviewText: I've owned an original kettle for the past 7 years and have loved every grill on it. It's older and a bit beat up from the elements, so I bought a new one just a bit ago. I looked around at other grills and decided I already had the best grill so I'll just refresh/upgrade what I already love! The copper color really pops! So I can put the ole reliable as a backup for when I host guests. These things can do it all, including smoking and bbq style!
Results.Title: So nice, I did it twice!

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd weber grill purchase in 30 years and it is still a quality product. This newest grill seems just as well built as my previous grills. I like the addition of the temp gauge in the lid! I won't have to drill a hole and ruin the finish adding one myself. Great 1st grill for a beginner griller or replacement for a user of many seasons. A little care will result in a grill that lasts for many years.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Grill still a great bargain

Results.ReviewText: Best grill construction ever, lightweight, easy to clean.
Results.Title: Best grill construction ever

Results.ReviewText: Weber never disappoints! I purchased this grill because I love the taste of charcoal grilled food. I know it takes longer, but it’s worth it in the end when it comes down to taste. I also used charcoal briquettes to slowly smoke some ribs. It took 6 hours for 2 racks of St Louis style ribs and the taste was fantastic! The new lid design was also helpful because I didn’t have to find somewhere to lay the lid while checking on the food
Results.Title: Great Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear you are having an issue with the lid hook. We want to know more and offer our assistance to get this resolved. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The hook inside the cover is not in a good spot. Very awkward when wanting to hang it on the kettle. It should have stayed where it was originally.
Results.Title: Hook inside cover

Results.ReviewText: I own a pellet smoker. After using the Weber kettle I prefer using the Webber. I get much better flavor from the Weber kettle barbecue
Results.Title: Great kettle barbecue

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
